intro: I travel to listen. Rainforests, rivers, caves, volcanoes: I go to record the voice of a place before it changes, and I come back with sounds that become albums, tools and ceremonies. Some of these journeys are open. You can come with me.

kinds.title: Recording expeditions
kinds.text: Small groups, wild places, early mornings. You learn field recording and deep listening beside me while I work. Simple lodging, real distance from the noise.

kinds.title: Sound & dance retreats
kinds.text: A held container in nature. Days of listening and rest, nights of dance and sound ceremony. Cacao Bass on the road, with the land as the fifth element.

titles.kinds: Two ways to travel with me
titles.upcoming_empty: The next journey is announced first in the letters. Sign up at the bottom of the page.
titles.host_text: Have land, a sanctuary or a community that wants to gather around sound? Tell me about your place and your people.

upcoming.title: Five Body Nourishment Journey to Calakmul
upcoming.text: Five days in the ancient forests of Calakmul, nourishing the five bodies with listening, ceremony and the living jungle. Details coming soon.

upcoming.title: Ometepe listening expedition
upcoming.text: Five days between two volcanoes: dawn recordings in the forest, lake hydrophones, a night of sound ceremony. Placeholder until dates are set.

past.caption: Tenerife, Canary Islands
past.text: Ten of us, on the tenth day of the tenth month, out at sea with the pilot whales. A hydrophone let us hear their calls and songs; ceremony, meditation and deep listening let us meet them as kin, part of one great web of life.

past.caption: Ometepe Island, Nicaragua
past.text: Two days with my community between the volcanoes: a mini-festival where we planted trees, opened with prayer and ritual, shared a cacao ceremony and danced into the night.

past.caption: Maderas Beach, Nicaragua
past.text: A trance ritual of remembrance. We walked out into the land, each finding a spot to tune into nature's rhythms, the way ancient lineages listened for their melodic codes, and downloaded our soul song: the frequency of our spirit.

past.caption: Huelgoat, Brittany, France
past.text: Slow walks in an old Breton forest of granite, moss and streams: recording what the stones and waters hold, and letting the forest set the rhythm of the day.
